author: Cosmo
honesty: Suggested animation parameters as data. Not tested in the live engine, on a phone or on a GBA.
units: metres, seconds, radians unless a name says _deg; forward +Z, car-left +X, Y up, y=0 is the tyre contact plane

rolling_spec.spin_rate_rad_s: omega = v / r  (v = forward speed m/s, r = wheel_radius_m)

three_wheel_radius_table.note: The brief asked for a rolling spec at three wheel radii: small / default / big (monster-tyre scale). spin rate omega = v/r in rad/s at 2, 6 and 14 m/s.

rolling_spec.turn: Ackermann: steer angle delta (rad), turn radius = wheelbase / tan(delta); inner front = atan(L/(Rt-T/2)), outer front = atan(L/(Rt+T/2)); max_steer_deg 28

body_bob.note: engine breathing; creature riders inherit it

drive.pitch_deg: clamp(-0.9 * accel_m_s2, -4, 4) (nose dips when braking, lifts when accelerating)
drive.roll_deg: clamp(0.35 * lateral_accel_m_s2, -5, 5) away from the turn

parked.note: Studio 17_roadster_parked: warm lamps, the car waits beside a crystal lamp; riders can hop out

reduced_motion.note: amp 0 on bob, pitch and roll, pulse_amp 0, wake off; spin may continue

suspension.note: cheap model: bob_y += (target - bob_y) * (1 - exp(-dt*2*pi*spring_hz)); wheels do not bob

planet_driving.note: Place the root at a surface point with local up = surface normal and forward = tangent. Keep the four tyre contact points on the heightfield and set pitch/roll from the ground normal, then add the state offsets. On very small planets raise ride height by 0.5*(R_planet - sqrt(R_planet^2 - wheelbase^2/4)) so the belly does not scrape.

sprite.note: same row order as livingworld_frames.json traveler_walk; rows = direction, columns = frame

attach.note: Parent the creature object to rider_L / rider_R (child of body_group) so it rides the bob. Driver = rider_L (+X, steering wheel). A rider never drives physics.
attach.zero_pose: rider nodes sit at y=0.58 m (seat cushion top), z=-0.40

tiny.note: fits a seat with room to spare, head just clears the windscreen top

small.note: the chibi cats: sits upright, head above the windscreen like Studio 15_roadster

medium.note: quadruped: lies/crouches on the cushion, head over the door

long.note: serpent: coils in the seat, head up beside the headrest; keep the tail inside the cockpit

tall.note: humanoid sprite: seated height ~0.8 m, legs tucked forward, hands on the wheel when in rider_L

riders.per_creature_note: Keys match lib/living-core/creatures.js (kitten, zeref, kairo, frost, kittenref, zeref64, velvetcoil, shardhowl) and lcx1 SPECIES. Names like Yewling are generated per beast and are never keys. Zeref entries are additive transform data only: his look is untouched.
